You are being evaluated on Continual-ARC, a lifelong stream of ARC-style grid puzzles.
Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

from collections import defaultdict,Counter
def solve(I):
    H=len(I); W=len(I[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for row in I for x in row); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # bar block: solid rectangle of one color covering >= half columns & full height per column
    cols={}
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if I[r][c]!=bg: cols.setdefault(c,[]).append(r)
    bc=set()
    for c,rws in cols.items():
        vals={I[r][c] for r in rws}
        if len(vals)==1 and min(rws)<=H*0.9 and max(rws)>=H*0.9: bc.add(c)
    mks=sorted((r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if c not in bc and I[r][c]!=bg)
    mcol=I[mks[0][0]][mks[0][1]]
    dr=(mks[-1][0]>mks[0][0])-(mks[-1][0]<mks[0][0]); dc=(mks[-1][1]-mks[0][1])*abs(dr)//max(abs(mks[-1][1]-mks[0][1]),1)
    def trace(start,d):
        pos=[start]; r,c=start; nm=0; v=None
        while True:
            nr,nc=r+d[0],c+d[1]
            if not(0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W): return None,'edge'
            v_=I[nr][nc]
            if v_==mcol:
                nm+=1
                if nm>len(mks): return None,'markerexhausted',nm
                pos.append((nr,nc)); r,c=nr,nc; continue
            if v_!=bg: return pos,'bar',(nr,nc)
            pos.append((nr,nc)); r,c=nr,nc
    best=None
    for s,e in [(mks[0],mks[-1]),(mks[-1],mks[0])]:
        dd=((e[0]>s[0])-(e[0]<s[0]), (e[1]>s[1])-(e[1]<s[1]))
        t,hit,info=trace(s,dd)
        if hit=='bar':
            best=(t,dd); break
    out=[row[:] for row in I]
    if best is None: return out
    seg,dd=best
    for r,c in seg:
        if out[r][c]==bg: out[r][c]=3
    # bounce origin: last cell of the incident path (or last marker cell if none free)
    bounce = seg[-1] if seg else mks[0]
    # obstacle side relative to bounce determines which component flips
    ob=info[2] if isinstance(info,tuple) and len(info)>2 else None
    if ob is None:  # edge
        # treat as mirror continuing? skip
        pass
    if ob:
        barpos=ob
        dvert=(barpos[0]-bounce[0])==0  # obstacle directly left/right -> flip dc
        nd=(dd[0],-dd[1]) if dvert else (-dd[0],dd[1])
    else:
        nd=(dd[0],-dd[1])  # default: flip horizontal (vertical bar)
    rr,cc=bounce
    while True:
        nr,nc=rr+nd[0],cc+nd[1]
        if not(0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W): break
        v=I[nr][nc]
        if v!=bg: break
        out[nr][nc]=3; rr,cc=nr,nc
    return out

G=load(); T=G['Test input']
# Test scene: bg=0 (large empty rect cols6-13 rows0-23); bars = 4-region (frame + inner block); markers 2 at (0,18),(1,17),(2,16),(3,15) diag toward col<=13 bar.
# Rule per demos: complete the billiard path. Verify on demos with the trace-through-markers version:
from collections import defaultdict,Counter
def solve(I):
    H=len(I);W=len(I[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for row in I for x in row); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cols=defaultdict(list)
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if I[r][c]!=bg: cols[c].append(r)
    bc=set()
    for c,rws in cols.items():
        vals={I[r][c] for r in rws}
        if len(vals)==1 and min(rws)<=H*0.9 and max(rws)>=H*0.9: bc.add(c)
    mks=sorted((r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if c not in bc and I[r][c]!=bg)
    mcol=I[mks[0][0]][mks[0][1]]
    dr=(mks[-1][0]>mks[0][0])-(mks[-1][0]<mks[0][0]); dc=(mks[-1][1]-mks[0][1])*abs(dr)//max(abs(mks[-1][1]-mks[0][1]),1)
    def trace(start,d):
        pos=[start];r,c=start
        while True:
            nr,nc=r+d[0],c+d[1]
            if not(0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W): return None,None,pos
            v_=I[nr][nc]
            if v_==mcol: pos.append((nr,nc));r,c=nr,nc;continue
            if v_!=bg: return 'bar',(nr,nc),pos
            pos.append((nr,nc));r,c=nr,nc
    best=None
    for s,e in [(mks[0],mks[-1]),(mks[-1],mks[0])]:
        dd=((e[0]>s[0])-(e[0]<s[0]),(e[1]>s[1])-(e[1]<s[1]))
        h,ob,pos=trace(s,dd)
        if h=='bar' and (best is None or len(pos)>len(best[2])): best=(h,ob,pos,dd)
    out=[row[:] for row in I]
    if best is None: return out
    ob,pos,dd=best[1],best[2],best[3]
    for r,c in pos:
        if out[r][c]==bg: out[r][c]=3
    bounce=pos[-1]
    dvert=(ob[0]==bounce[0])
    nd=(dd[0],-dd[1]) if dvert else (-dd[0],dd[1])
    rr,cc=bounce
    while True:
        nr,nc=rr+nd[0],cc+nd[1]
        if not(0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W): break
        if I[nr][nc]==bg: out[nr][nc]=3;rr,cc=nr,nc
        else: break
    return out
for k in ['Demo pair 2 input','Demo pair 3 input']:
    print(k, solve(G[k])==G[k.replace('input','output')])
print(json.dumps(solve(G['Test input'])))

def trace(I, start, d, draw=True, skip_marker=True):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0]);cnt=Counter(x for row in I for x in row);bgc=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    others=[v for v in set(cnt) if v!=bgc];bar=max(others,key=lambda v:cnt[v])
    mcol=[v for v in others if v!=bar][0]
    mk={(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]==mcol}
    obst=lambda r,c: 0<=r<H and 0<=c<W and I[r][c]==bar
    seg=[]
    rr,cc=start;nd=d;bounce=False
    while True:
        nr,nc=rr+nd[0],cc+nd[1]
        if not(0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W): break

            nd=(-nd[0],nd[1]) if None==None else nd
            break
        seg.append((nr,nc)); rr,cc=nr,nc
    return seg

def beam_path(I):
    H=len(I); Wd=len(I[0])
    vals=[v for row in I for v in row]
    cnt={v:vals.count(v) for v in set(vals)}
    # bar = most common non-bg color? bg = most common overall
    bg=max(cnt,key=lambda v:cnt[v])

    mks={(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(Wd) if I[r][c]==mkc}
    rest=set(vals); brcells=[v for v in rest if v!=mkc]

    bar={(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(Wd) if I[r][c]==barc}
    import collections
    # group bar cells into components; barrier faces: the component(s) the ray bounces off

    def linehits(p,dr,dc):
        k=1
        while True:
            q=(p[0]+k*dr,p[1]+k*dc)
            if not(0<=q[0]<H and 0<=q[1]<Wd): return None
            if I[q[0]][q[1]]==barc: return k
            k+=1
    best=None
    for p in mks:

            for dc in (-1,1):
                if (dr,dc)==( (p[0]-list(mks)[0][0],0)) or abs((p[0]-mks.pop().__next__()[0])): pass
    # simpler: for each marker cell, each diagonal dir: step until non-bg; score by distance
    scores=[]
    for p in mks:
        for dr,dc in [(1,1),(1,-1),(-1,1),(-1,-1)]:
            k=0
            q=p
            while True:
                q=(q[0]+dr,q[1]+dc)
                if not(0<=q[0]<H and 0<=q[1]<Wd): break
                if I[q[0]][q[1]]==barc: scores.append((k,p,dr,dc)); break
                k+=1
    scores.sort()
    k,start,dr,dc=scores[0]
    # walk from start toward barrier: incoming arm
    arm=[]
    q=start
    while True:
        q=(q[0]+dr,q[1]+dc)
        if not(0<=q[0]<H and 0<=q[1]<Wd): break
        if I[q[0]][q[1]]!=bg: break
        arm.append(q)
    # bounce: the barrier cell hit is start+k*(dr,dc)
    hit=(start[0]+dr*k,start[1]+dc*k)
    # determine face: if hitting vertical barrier (bar cell adjacent horizontally) reflect dc; check bar shape at hit
    # local bar neighborhood decides: horizontal face if cell below/above hit is bar too => reflect dc
    horiz_face = (hit[0]+1<H and I[hit[0]+1][hit[1]]==barc) or (hit[0]>0 and I[hit[0]-1][hit[1]]==barc)
    vert_face = not horiz_face
    ndr,ndc=(dr,dc)
    if vert_face: ndc=-ndc
    else: ndr=-ndr
    # outgoing from last arm cell
    out=[]
    q=arm[-1] if arm else start
    nr,nc=q[0]+ndr,q[1]+ndc
    while 0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<Wd:
        if I[nr][nc]!=bg: break
        out.append((nr,nc))
        nr+=ndr; nc+=ndc
    O=[[bg]*Wd for _ in range(H)]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(Wd):
            if I[r][c]==barc or I[r][c]==mkc: O[r][c]=I[r][c]
    for r,c in arm+out: O[r][c]=3
    return O

def solve(I):
    H=len(I); Wd=len(I[0])
    vals=[v for row in I for v in row]
    cnt={}
    for v in vals: cnt[v]=cnt.get(v,0)+1
    bg=max(cnt,key=lambda v:cnt[v])
    others=[v for v in cnt if v!=bg]
    mkc=min(others,key=lambda v:cnt[v])
    barc=[v for v in others if v!=mkc][0]
    mks={(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(Wd) if I[r][c]==mkc}
    bar={(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(Wd) if I[r][c]==barc}
    rs=[p[0] for p in bar]; cs=[p[1] for p in bar]
    vert = (max(rs)-min(rs)) >= (max(cs)-min(cs))   # vertical wall: flip column comp
    def linehits(p,dr,dc):
        k=1
        while True:
            q=(p[0]+k*dr,p[1]+k*dc)
            if not(0<=q[0]<H and 0<=q[1]<Wd): return None
            if I[q[0]][q[1]]==barc: return k
            k+=1
    best=None
    for p in mks:
        for dr,dc in [(1,1),(1,-1),(-1,1),(-1,-1)]:
            h=linehits(p,dr,dc)
            if h is not None and (best is None or h<best[0]):
                best=(h,p[0],p[1],dr,dc)
    _,start_r,start_c,dr0,dc0=best
    if vert: ndr,ndc=dr0,-dc0
    else: ndr,ndc=-dr0,dc0
    arm=[]
    q=(start_r,start_c)
    while True:
        n=(q[0]+ndr,q[1]+ndc)
        if not(0<=n[0]<H and 0<=n[1]<Wd): break
        if I[n[0]][n[1]]!=bg: break
        arm.append(n)
        q=n
    out=[]
    q=arm[-1] if arm else (start_r,start_c)
    nr,nc=q[0]+ndr,q[1]+ndc
    while 0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<Wd:
        if I[nr][nc]!=bg: break
        out.append((nr,nc))
        nr+=ndr; nc+=ndc
    O=[[bg]*Wd for _ in range(H)]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(Wd):
            if I[r][c]==barc or I[r][c]==mkc: O[r][c]=I[r][c]
    for r,c in arm+out: O[r][c]=3
    return O
for name in ['Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4','Demo pair 5','Demo pair 6','Demo pair 7']:
    i_=G2[name+' input']; o_=G2[name+' output']
    ok=solve(i_)==o_
    print(name,'OK' if ok else 'MISMATCH')

import numpy as np
def solve(g):
    A=[row[:] for row in g]; H,W=len(A),len(A[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg=int(Counter(x for r in A for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0])
    # components
    from scipy.ndimage import label
    lab,n=label(np.array(A)!=bg)
    comps=[]
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        pts=list(zip(*np.where(lab==i)))
        comps.append(pts)

from collections import Counter
import numpy as np, scipy.ndimage

def f(g):
    A=[row[:] for row in g]; H,W=len(A),len(A[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in A for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    def comps_of(col):
        m=np.array([[A[r][c]==col for c in range(W)] for r in range(H)])
        ln,nn=scipy.ndimage.label(m, structure=np.ones((3,3),int))
        return [set(zip(*np.where(ln==i))) for i in range(1,int(nn)+1)] if nn else []
    cs={col:comps_of(col) for col in set(cnt)-{bg}}
    best=None; bpts=set()
    for col,cl in cs.items():
        for p in cl:
            if best is None or len(p)>best:
                best=len(p); bpts=p
    marks={(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if A[r][c]!=bg and (r,c) not in bpts}
    M=sorted(marks)
    D=[(-1,1),(1,-1),(-1,-1),(1,1)]
    cands=[d for d in D if all((p[0]-M[0][0])*d[1]==(p[1]-M[0][1])*d[0] for p in M)]
    def ext(start,dv):
        path=[]; cur=start
        while True:
            nc=(cur[0]+dv[0],cur[1]+dv[1])
            if not(0<=nc[0]<H and 0<=nc[1]<W): break
            if nc in bpts or nc in marks: break
            path.append(nc); cur=nc
        return path
    segs=[(start,d,p) for start in [min(M),max(M)] for d in cands for p in [ext(start,d)] if p]
    adj=lambda dv,p: bool(p) and ((p[-1][0]+dv[0],p[-1][1]+dv[1]) in bpts)
    good=[s for s in segs if adj(s[1],s[2])]
    pick = max(good,key=lambda s:len(s[2])) if good else max(segs,key=lambda s:len(s[2]))
    for q in pick[2]: A[q[0]][q[1]]=3
    dv=pick[1]; v=pick[2][-1]
    nb=(v[0]+dv[0],v[1]+dv[1])
    wall_vert = nb in bpts and nb[0]==v[0]
    wall_horz = nb in bpts and nb[1]==v[1]
    if wall_vert and not wall_horz: wr,wc=dv[0],-dv[1]
    elif wall_horz and not wall_vert: wr,wc=-dv[0],dv[1]
    elif wall_vert and wall_horz: wr,wc=(-dv[0],-dv[1])
    else: wr,wc=(-dv[0],-dv[1])
    pc=(v[0]+wr,v[1]+wc)
    if 0<=pc[0]<H and 0<=pc[1]<W and pc not in bpts and pc not in marks and A[pc[0]][pc[1]]==bg:
        A[pc[0]][pc[1]]=3
        while True:
            pc=(pc[0]+wr,pc[1]+wc)
            if not(0<=pc[0]<H and 0<=pc[1]<W) or pc in bpts or pc in marks or A[pc[0]][pc[1]]!=bg: break
            A[pc[0]][pc[1]]=3
    return A
